# Synthetic Operations Requirements Quality Checklist: Eino Supervisor Template

**Purpose**: Review whether the synthetic dormant-customer analysis requirements are complete, clear, consistent, measurable, and ready for implementation.
**Created**: 2026-09-25
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md), [plan.md](../plan.md), [tasks.md](../tasks.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Does the feature specification define the synthetic audience scenario and its relationship to the existing read-only operations story, rather than leaving it only in the plan? [Gap, Spec §User Story 1, Plan §下一批计划]
- [x] CHK002 Are the fixed snapshot date, complete synthetic fixture, expected matching IDs/count, and ordering contract specified in one authoritative requirement location? [Completeness, Plan §下一批计划, Tasks T027]
- [x] CHK003 Are the only supported audience predicates and their date/amount boundary semantics stated precisely, including whether “over 30 days” is strict and “at least 7 days” is inclusive? [Clarity, Plan §下一批计划, Tasks T027]
- [x] CHK004 Does the requirement define the zero-match result and the behavior for a missing or invalid `as_of` value? [Gap, Tasks T027/T030]
- [x] CHK005 Are the allowed request and response fields for audience filtering fully specified, including units/types for `spend_365d_total`, maximum ID count, and output size? [Completeness, Tasks T027/T030]
- [x] CHK006 Are the summary's permitted fields, segment definitions, follow-up suggestion scope, and output limits defined without allowing identity inference or external delivery? [Completeness, Plan §阶段 2, Tasks T033/T034]
- [x] CHK007 Does the simulated outreach requirement specify exactly which audience reference or anonymous IDs may be submitted, and whether it is an independent run rather than a continuation of the analysis run? [Clarity, Plan §阶段 3, Tasks T035/T036]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK008 Is the phrase “synthetic consent state allowed” explicitly distinguished from real-world contact consent or legal authorization? [Clarity, Plan §数据边界, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK009 Is “unsupported criterion” defined with representative examples and a clear distinction between rejecting a criterion and returning an empty audience? [Ambiguity, Plan §阶段 1, Tasks T029/T030]
- [x] CHK010 Are “bounded result”, “bounded summary”, and “existing size limit” tied to explicit field/count/byte limits in the requirements? [Ambiguity, Tasks T030/T032/T033/T036]
- [x] CHK011 Is the expected segment vocabulary and deterministic ordering defined so different implementations cannot produce equally plausible but incompatible summaries? [Gap, Tasks T032/T033]
- [x] CHK012 Is the user-facing request wording for filtering and “analyze then summarize” fixed sufficiently to distinguish one-step from two-step routing? [Clarity, Plan §阶段 1-2, Tasks T031/T034]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK013 Do the requirements reconcile the existing Spec's generic operations stories with the new dormant-customer scenario, including whether the new scenario belongs to P1/P2/P3 acceptance? [Consistency, Spec §User Stories, Plan §下一批计划]
- [x] CHK014 Are the one-step audience flow and the maximum-two-step summary flow consistently ordered across Spec, Plan, and Tasks, including which acceptance must pass before summary work? [Consistency, Spec §FR-018/SC-010, Plan §阶段关系, Tasks T029-T034]
- [x] CHK015 Are simulated outreach requirements consistent with the two-step plan limit and explicit prohibition on a single-run filter-summary-outreach chain? [Consistency, Plan §阶段 3/阶段关系, Tasks T035/T036]
- [x] CHK016 Do task dependencies correctly reflect whether tests are intentionally test-first or depend on a previously defined input/output contract? [Consistency, Tasks T029/T030/T032/T033]
- [x] CHK017 Are the date predicate, missing `last_touch_at` behavior, and consent filter consistent between Plan, Tasks, and the eventual Spec acceptance criteria? [Consistency, Plan §数据边界, Tasks T027/T028]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK018 Can the expected audience result be judged objectively from a fixed date, fixture rows, exact predicates, and expected IDs/count without relying on wall-clock time? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, Tasks T027/T028]
- [x] CHK019 Are the summary's expected count, spend aggregation, segment labels, and suggestion constraints concrete enough to distinguish a correct result from arbitrary prose? [Measurability, Plan §阶段 2, Tasks T032/T033]
- [x] CHK020 Are approval acceptance criteria explicit for both rejection and approval, including the exact definition of a simulated write and the repeated-resume count? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002/SC-003, Tasks T035/T036]
- [x] CHK021 Are recovery acceptance criteria explicit about the interruption point, completed-step identity, event sequence scope, and unique terminal event? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005, Tasks T037]

## Scenario and Edge Coverage

- [x] CHK022 Are primary, no-match, malformed-query, unsupported-criterion, and invalid-date outcomes separately specified? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, Tasks T027-T030]
- [x] CHK023 Does the requirements set define whether absent `last_touch_at` means never contacted and whether that qualifies under the seven-day rule? [Edge Case, Tasks T028]
- [x] CHK024 Are boundary-date cases defined for exactly 30 days since last order and exactly 7 days since last touch? [Edge Case, Plan §数据边界, Tasks T028]
- [x] CHK025 Are malformed, oversized, extra-field, and identity-bearing first-step handoffs addressed as requirement-level rejection cases for the summary step? [Coverage, Constitution §II, Tasks T032/T033]
- [x] CHK026 Are malformed or identity-bearing outreach inputs explicitly rejected, and is the required approval/idempotency behavior tied to this synthetic scenario? [Coverage, Constitution §III, Tasks T035/T036]
- [x] CHK027 Are interruption/recovery requirements limited to the promised in-process or persisted scope, without implying cross-process Eino recovery that remains deferred? [Clarity, Spec §SC-005, Plan §延期能力, Tasks T037]

## Non-Functional Requirements and Boundaries

- [x] CHK028 Do requirements explicitly prohibit real CRM access, real customer data, real contact details, and real message delivery throughout the synthetic flow? [Security, Spec §Assumptions, Plan §数据边界]
- [x] CHK029 Are privacy and data-minimization requirements explicit for fixture fields, Tool results, SSE events, logs, and checkpoints? [Completeness, Constitution §Configuration, Prompt and Data Boundaries]
- [x] CHK030 Are runtime limits for audience IDs, Tool result bytes, summary bytes, and execution steps consistent with existing global budgets? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003/FR-016, Tasks T030/T033]
- [x] CHK031 Are deferred capabilities (real CRM, authoritative consent, real messaging, three-step runs, parallel/DAG, real-model Worker ToolCall, and cross-process Eino recovery) clearly separated from this batch's acceptance scope? [Assumption, Plan §延期能力, Tasks §Deferred]

## Dependencies and Assumptions

- [x] CHK032 Is the assumption that the synthetic fixture is small, immutable, and safely shareable stated, including whether multiple requests always use the same snapshot? [Assumption, Plan §数据边界, Tasks T027]
- [x] CHK033 Are the ownership and source of truth for the fixture/query contract, Tool JSON schema, prompt examples, and HTTP examples identified without competing definitions? [Dependency, Plan §Documentation Deliverables, Tasks T027/T030/T031/T034]
- [x] CHK034 Is the relationship between the independent outreach run and the prior audience result explicit enough to avoid implying cross-run state or implicit customer-data transfer? [Ambiguity, Plan §阶段关系, Tasks T035/T036]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `$speckit-specify` and `$speckit-clarify`.
- Add reviewer comments or findings inline and link them to the relevant source document.
